title: Synthesis, in silico and in vitro studies of aminopyrimidine hybrids as EGFR TK inhibitors and anti-proliferative agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36895-36906
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02524A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wael Shehta, Basant Farag, Shaker Youssif, Samar El-Kalyoubi, Sherin M. Elfeky
Two pyrimidine hybrid series (6a–g, 10a–d) were synthesized. Compounds 6c and 10b showed anti-proliferative activity against MCF-7, strong EGFR-TK inhibition, and docking confirmed effective binding. In silico studies suggest safe, orally bioavailable candidates.
